tokens.statement: The cited experiment reports coherent exciton-polaron beats in CsPbI3 nanocrystals at 2 K with 3.2 meV and 5.1 meV modes.
Temporal quantum beats are not an observed spatial spiral.
A logarithmic spiral using sqrt(3)/2 is a prescribed geometry, not a derived black-hole orbit.
144 kHz and 288 kHz are treated as an external fundamental and second harmonic, not direct atomic single-photon ionization energies.
Plasma conductivity depends on frequency, collisions, ionization, temperature and magnetic field and is generally tensorial.
Ordered mean inflow can coexist with microscopic damping, heating, transport and radiation.
Electrical corona discharge and astrophysical hot corona are distinct regimes.
Non-parallel density and electron-temperature gradients can seed magnetic field through a Biermann-like term.
The accretion flow has an ordered mean structure plus turbulence, shocks, reconnection and phase mixing.
Diamond bonding is blocked in fully ionized plasma; recondensation is only a candidate during cooling or quench.
A dense carbon-oxygen compact companion is not equivalent to a confirmed planet made entirely of ordinary sp3 diamond.
GPT transforms contextual representations and predicts tokens; it does not possess a demonstrated medical intention or volition.
Compression may close a branch too early, so negation, modality, exceptions, numbers and units must be preserved.
Permutations and scale are compiled by RafPolimata after authority, unit and claim gates.
Mapa stores pointers and dependencies and does not become the source authority.
The unified session capsule does not validate RLL cosmology, a laboratory plasma, an astrophysical source or exoplanet composition.
Microscopic collision means scattering or field-mediated quantum interaction, not literal hard-sphere contact.
Compression can heat, excite, dissociate and ionize, but it does not automatically create subparticles; nuclear, pair and subnuclear channels require process-specific thresholds and cross sections.
Pauli exclusion concerns occupation of the same quantum state, while electron spin contributes magnetic moment; neither statement alone supplies a macroscopic magnetic or gravitational solution.
Matter, electromagnetic fields and radiation contribute to stress-energy, but an equivalent mass-density proxy is not an Einstein-equation backreaction solution or a new plasma-gravity force.
Magnetic field lines are representations of the field and evolve with plasma flow through induction, advection, diffusion and reconnection; they are not material strings pulled directly by gravity.
Photon momentum transfer produces thrust proportional to power/c and radiative acceleration proportional to opacity times flux/c; the Eddington ratio benchmarks competition with gravity.
